releaseNotes:
• 3-Tab Bottom Navigation: Seamless switching between Home, Scorecards, and Player Rankings
• Redesigned Home Screen Dashboard: Clean cricket central with live match hero card, club statistics, latest result spotlight, and quick actions
• Dedicated Scorecards Screen: Search by team or match ID, filter by status (All, Live, Finished) and date calendar
• Gully Cricket Rules (X Players = X Wickets): Each team gets full X wickets. When X-1 wickets fall, the lone batsman continues batting alone until all-out
• Lone Batsman Live Scoring: Ball-by-ball strike retention and live visual indicator during lone batsman innings
• Real-time Active Users live presence badge
• In-app auto-update with direct APK installation
